criteria.description: Every section name says what it contains - ORBITS, HOLDINGS, RETURNS, RISK, CORRELATION, NEWS, TRADES, EARNINGS - in the room, the planet panel, the Systems Manual, the below-1024px fallback, and every accessible name. No jargon noun (PLOT, MANIFEST, SCOPE, HAZARD, SIGNALS, COMMS, LOG, LAUNCH, TELEMETRY, TRANSMISSIONS, EGRESS) survives anywhere in rendered output.

The ten-second test passes on a fresh 1440x900 planet-panel capture: up today (hero), trending (chart title plus shape), how much do I hold (stats), how wild is it (stats), anything happening (earnings chip plus news). Every answer is findable without scrolling, squinting, or translating a term.

Every displayed figure carries its window in exactly one of two legal forms: an attached small-caps window word, or a physically adjacent header within 20px. No third form exists and no bare figure appears on any surface, including the Mission Control hero and the sun chip.

The selected planet's disc is fully outside the panel rectangle in the shipped view at every zoom the camera allows; when the panel would overlap the disc the camera pulls back. Measured as a geometric invariant from the live shipped view, not asserted.
Mission Control scrolls with a sticky 64px strip; the radar scrolls away rather than pinning or shrinking; section tabs jump-scroll to their sections; ESC leaves from any scroll depth.

The chart's range toggle visibly changes both the title figure and the plotted shape across 7D, 30D, SINCE BUY and MAX. The benchmark overlay toggle is absent - not disabled and not replaced by an error bar - when no same-period benchmark series exists.

Cut items are absent from rendered output: the duplicate unlabelled panel hero and the SYSTEMS MANUAL chip at panel top. A holding with zero linkable headlines renders no NEWS zone rather than an empty frame.
No error furniture renders: the VOO UNAVAILABLE bar does not appear, and a missing benchmark removes its toggle silently. Nothing displays a zero as if it were a real measurement.

CORRELATION carries a plain-language explanation of what correlation says about this portfolio - meaning, relevance to concentration, and stated limitation - adjacent to the visual, described neutrally with no investment advice and no unexplained jargon.

Every rendered news headline is an anchor carrying a non-empty http(s) href. Headlines lacking a usable URL are filtered at the data layer and never rendered with a dead or empty link, in both the room NEWS section and the planet panel.
The bottom legend bar is first-visit only: it is dismissed on first interaction, does not return on later visits, and remains summonable from the Systems Manual.
Zooming out rubber-bands at the overview framing. No sector-map state is reachable from the shipped UI and no path to OBSERVATORY-GROWTH exists from any control or camera action.
The authored-system machinery (systems/*.json, hollow-core suns, the hydration code) remains present in the codebase behind a flag and is provably unreachable from the UI - retained, not deleted.

Draft weights total exactly 100.0% after every operation across a randomised sequence of grow, shrink, siphon, type-in, keyboard and zero operations. The invariant holds by construction from the 200 integer half-percent units with largest-remainder rounding; no validation or correction message is reachable.

Pro-rata breathing preserves the relative mix of the seven untouched holdings; the siphon latch moves weight between exactly two circles and leaves the other six unchanged; a circle at 0.0% docks on the pit rail still labelled and can be returned to the track.

Under reduced motion the rig holds seeded stations with a direction chevron ahead of each circle and static trails, and every encoding - direction, speed rank, magnitude ramp, size, ghost ring - remains readable in the frozen state.
THE WEEK, CONCENTRATION and DRIFT all update live during a drag and settle on release, verified by sampling the rendered readouts mid-gesture.

The draft is encoded in the URL as eight half-unit integers; browser Back undoes a committed edit and Forward replays it; COPY TEST LINK yields a URL that restores the identical draft in a fresh context.
RESET TO BOOK requires two deliberate actions within the arm window and cannot fire on a single click; the reset is itself a history entry, so Back un-resets it.

Brand-first entry: the planet view arrives with the nearest carved capital facing the camera, then resumes decorative spin. The phase is still set under reduced motion; only the transition is not animated.

carried_from_section_10.measurement_at_carry: Unjudgeable in §10: blocked by the same inspector-panel occlusion as DEF-02 - the panel covers 96.8-100% of the sampled band, so the verifier cannot see what it measures. The owner independently reports he cannot see the planet at all.
carried_from_section_10.owner_observation: I honestly cannot see the planet at all because of the bug where the terminal covers up the screen.
carried_from_section_10.resolved_in_11_by: The §3 planet-panel rebuild keeps the planet visible and shrinks the panel; then re-run the shipped-view verifier and record the result. Do NOT weaken the assertion.
carried_from_section_10.rule: Must be re-run and recorded in §11. May not be closed by assertion.

criteria.description: The planet panel occupies a fixed right rail of at most 380px at 1440x900 - narrower than UNIVERSE_LEGIBILITY_MOCK.html, per the owner's 'slightly too big' note - and the selected planet is anchored at screen x approximately 30%. Both measured from the live shipped view in pixels.

The panel renders the five-zone stack in order (header, hero, windows line, chart, stats line, news, footer buttons) at the specified sizes: 15px body, 56px hero, at most 60 words total, and each figure appearing exactly once.

WEIGHT renders with no arrow and no sign. The sun chip reads PORTFOLIO . TODAY with its arrow and figure and carries no mood word such as WEAK. XIRR renders as an em-dash with '(needs 90d)' while history is under 90 days, never an annualized figure and never a zero.
A 1440x900 capture shows the selected planet visible beside the open panel, unoccluded, with its disc and carved marks in the frame.

The chart is readable at panel scale (170px tall) and room scale (320px): three horizontal axis hairlines with left-hand labels, a solid baseline at zero, start and end dots, and an endpoint chip carrying the closing figure in signal colour. Trace colour remains instrument amber; signal colour appears only on the title arrow and endpoint chip.

Mission Control's descent renders in the specified order - ORBITS, HOLDINGS, RETURNS, RISK, CORRELATION plus EARNINGS, NEWS, TRADES - each section full width at its specified height, with the 64px strip pinned above.

Every orbital ring is a full circle whose far-side alpha is at least 0.22, sampled on at least two rings in the live view, peaking at 0.55 over the 90-degree arc centred on its planet. The falloff is a token pair {peak, floor} rather than a single constant, and the frame does not read as uniform graph paper.
The Mission Control radar draws exactly one ellipse per holding. Regression coverage prevents the double-ellipse defect from returning, asserted from rendered geometry rather than source text.

The sun's disc diameter is at least 1.5x the largest planet's disc diameter, measured in pixels in the live 1440x900 capture, with sunRadius = max(2.8, 1.6 x largest planet radius) in the scene model. Scale is measured in pixels, not asserted in scene units.
The PORTFOLIO readout participates in label-collision avoidance as an obstacle, not only as a peer; no ticker label overlaps it in the live capture.

Ghost rings render as dashed cream circles at each holding's real-weight diameter, concentric with the disc, and disappear when the GHOST toggle is switched off. The tank rack shows a cream notch at the real weight on every row.

Trails carry direction and magnitude in a single 1440x900 still frame: arc between 26 and 46 degrees (owner-directed shortening, spec section 5.4), ramp lightness for magnitude, and a fixed 12% white-hot head acting as a calibration reference. Every clause other than the arc band is unchanged from §10.

carried_from_section_10.measurement_at_carry: Blocked on TST-03's remaining NBIS sample, which the owner reports renders correctly. sample-live-rgb.mjs aborts on NBIS at deltaE 33.123 against a <=8 gate.
carried_from_section_10.owner_observation: NBIS trail is the same brightness as the other red planets.
carried_from_section_10.resolved_in_11_by: Follows TST-03's sampler re-derivation, plus the new owner-directed 26-46 degree arc band. Do NOT loosen deltaE.
carried_from_section_10.arc_band_change: 36-64 degrees becomes 26-46 degrees. This is an owner-directed design-target change ('Why are the trails so long... shorten them, somewhere between the two'), not a gate weakening. The deltaE gate, the ramp-lightness clause and the 12% white-hot head are unchanged.

criteria.description: Marks read as carved into the terrain - sharing its lighting and grain, embossed into the normal map, edge-eroded - at three capitals 120 degrees apart within +/-18 degrees latitude, with at least one instance facing the camera within 60 degrees at all times.

carried_from_section_10.measurement_at_carry: Unjudgeable in §10: blocked by the same inspector-panel occlusion as DEF-02, which covers 96.8-100% of the sampled band.
carried_from_section_10.owner_observation: I do not see any logos on any of the planets.

criteria.description: Brand marks render with correct chirality on the rendered sphere for all eight worlds, proven by a chirality assertion against the shipped view, not by eye. A verifier that samples the mark directly, rather than a terrain-dominated equatorial column-mean profile, is legitimate §11 work.

carried_from_section_10.measurement_at_carry: The shipped-view chirality verifier aborts on COST and fails 6 of 8 worlds. The inspector panel covers 96.8-100% of the sampled band, so the verifier cannot see what it measures. Two authorised texture regenerations moved the panel-free correlation margin by 0.018 and 0.021, inside the 0.002-0.011 round-to-round drift of five untouched worlds, and did not invert sign - mirroring a mark must invert a correlation that reads that mark, so the column-mean greyscale profile cannot discriminate handedness and substantiates neither pass nor fail.
carried_from_section_10.owner_observation: I do not see any logos on any of the planets.
carried_from_section_10.resolved_in_11_by: The planet-panel rebuild keeps the planet visible and shrinks the panel; then re-run the shipped-view verifier and record the result. A verifier that samples the mark directly is legitimate §11 work. Do NOT weaken the assertion.
carried_from_section_10.rule: Must be re-run and recorded in §11. May not be closed by assertion.

criteria.description: Below 1024px the existing tested 2D fallback ships as-is: zero WebGL, a genuinely reflowed semantic list, no horizontal page overflow at 390px or 320px, and no interactive target smaller than 44x44 CSS pixels.
The below-1024px fallback carries every renamed noun and every window word, verified in the rendered DOM at 390x844 rather than in source.

Draft weights are fully keyboard-adjustable and never drag-only: Tab moves focus circle to circle with a visible focus ring, left/right arrows adjust by 0.5%, Shift by 5%, Space latches the focused circle as counterparty, and Enter opens type-in on a readout.
An aria-live polite region announces each committed weight change in the form 'ASML 30.0%. Others adjusted.', verified from the rendered accessibility tree.

Every new or changed text role meets its contrast floor, computed from source tokens by a regression test rather than asserted: window words #d5ba8c on glass #010806 at or above 10:1, chart baseline #f4dba8, 15px body cream, stencil cream #f0e2c4 on case shell #2b2723, amber on dish glass #0a0c10, and every labelHex rim on dish glass.

Under reduced motion the room uses plain native scroll with no scroll-linked effects of any kind, the flight case is present without lid animation, and hierarchy, facts, destinations and focus behaviour are all preserved.

The half-unit ledger is covered by property-style tests over randomised operation sequences asserting the invariant sum of 200 units and largest-remainder rounding behaviour, including the zero/pit-rail and re-entry paths.

The rig's mix-held return matches simulateRebalanced (one rebalance at window start) to 1e-9 over the same window, differing only in the weights, using the existing steadyMarket fixture pattern. The tested engine is the oracle.

Rendered behaviour is verified by scene-graph, DOM, pixel or geometry assertions. No new expect(source).toContain(...) guard is introduced as coverage for rendered behaviour, and no §11 criterion is graded from source reading alone.

npm test passes with zero failures across the full suite. No test is skipped, weakened, or deleted to achieve it, and the count does not fall below the 527 green at section start except where a test retires with the code it covered - each such retirement named explicitly.

The trail sampler asserts hue lock within 10 degrees, deltaE*ab no greater than 8 against the payload-derived expectation from rampForWeekly, and ordering across same-direction holdings - for every holding in the fixture, not a sampled subset. Literal-hex baselines survive only for flat, comet and sun tokens. The sample point and expected value are re-derived against the rebuilt view.

carried_from_section_10.measurement_at_carry: sample-live-rgb.mjs aborts on NBIS at deltaE 33.123 against a <=8 gate. The authorised taper-floor fix (0.45 -> 0.85) widened every ribbon 1.89x and took IBM from deltaE 3.522 to 0.396, so the fix landed and worked; NBIS moved only 33.846 -> 30.522, so width was never the cause. The 49px cross-section through the published sample point is a ~12px band peaking at red 93 against the model's 179, with zero pixels within 2; the same NBIS arc reaches deltaE 3.44 some 165px away.
carried_from_section_10.owner_observation: NBIS trail is the same brightness as the other red planets.
carried_from_section_10.resolved_in_11_by: Re-derive the sampler - the published data-trail-sample-x/y projection or the ribbon's angular sweep - against the rebuilt view, and reconcile it with what a viewer actually sees. Do NOT loosen deltaE.
carried_from_section_10.rule: Must be re-run and recorded in §11. May not be closed by assertion.

criteria.description: The embedded legacy dashboard is deleted from the Mission Control route along with its Recharts instances - deleted, not restyled and not hidden. Its data is redistributed into the room's own voice (the dollar cards become one owner-only VALUE line in HOLDINGS); anything not redistributed is named explicitly in the handoff, per PHASE10.md ground rule 15.

The radar pauses its animation when off-screen via IntersectionObserver, and below-fold sections lazy-mount on idle or first scroll without layout shift or a flash of empty room. Both measured at runtime, not asserted from source.
npm run build exits 0, the route list is otherwise unchanged apart from the retired /compare page, and the /share route smoke check passes.

The route-owned long task stays under 50ms across five fresh contexts at 1440x900 with CPU 2x throttling, with raw per-run output committed. Not baseline-subtracted, not redefined. No post-processing pass is added. This section should be a net refund against the budget.

carried_from_section_10.measurement_at_carry: measure-long-tasks.mjs unmodified, five fresh 1440x900 CPU-2x contexts, not baseline-subtracted: 65/57/58/58/57 ms against an unchanged 50 ms ceiling. Unmoved across five rounds (57-61, 56-62, 55-61, 56-60, 57-65). The round-3 CDP profile attributes 34.3 ms self time to Three.js shader-program acquisition (getParameters/getProgramCacheKey) and clears texture upload.

criteria.description: The DRAFT rig is owner-gated in §11: the public /share view emits no DRAFT tab and no rig markup - not hidden by CSS, not rendered at all - verified against unauthenticated rendered HTML and covered by a canary-style regression test.
The mandatory simulations banner appears byte-identical to SIMULATIONS_BANNER in src/lib/compare-copy.ts on every view that renders rig data, verified against the rendered text.
Nothing in the DRAFT rig carries a dollar amount, verified by scanning the rendered output for a currency pattern rather than by reading the source.

/share renders zero dollar amounts and zero owner-only fields after the rebuild, including the public trades view. The existing privacy canary tests pass unmodified - no canary is edited, relaxed, or deleted in this section.

The public/owner field partition is unchanged by this section: no field crosses the line in either direction. The VALUE column and the dollar line remain owner-view only, and the authenticated/public split mechanism itself is untouched.
